description: Intent i017 (SNAPSHOT=s04, BRANCH=ioctl-sock-usercopy-string) complete. Final artifact at agent-state/findings/i017.json with snapshots_checked=["s04"], 3 findings, all quotes verified literal within their <=100-line ranges. FINDINGS: (1) drivers/s390/cio/cio_inject.c:98-103 (high) — crw_inject_write (debugfs 'crw_inject', mode 0200) copies attacker-length lbuf bytes via vmemdup_user(buf, lbuf) into an exactly-lbuf-sized buffer with no NUL terminator or +1 slot, then immediately sscanf(buffer, "%x %x %x %x %x %x %x", ...) scans it as a C string; all-non-NUL input of length lbuf makes vsscanf read past the allocation (KASAN slab-OOB, seed-equivalent mechanism). Only guard is the cio_inject_enabled static branch; no memdup_user_nul/strndup_user/terminator between copy and use. (2) drivers/net/ethernet/intel/ice/ice_debugfs.c:174-184 (high) — four handlers (module_write 174/184, nr_messages 260/264, enable 335/339, log_size 431/435) do memdup_user(buf, count) exact-size then sscanf(cmd_buf, "%s", user_val) with no terminator; count caps (8/4/2/5) bound the overread but the invariant violation and OOB read are identical to the seed; root-only 0600 debugfs bounds reachability. (3) drivers/net/ethernet/brocade/bna/bnad_debugfs.c:315-319 (high) — bfa-seed twin: memdup_user(buf, nbytes) then sscanf(kern_buf, "%x:%x", ...) with no memdup_user_nul/strndup_user (also regwr at 375-379); same Brocade driver family and exact shape as the seed commit 13d0cecb4626. REJECTED with evidence: rvu_debugfs.c:1002-1008 safe (count+1 alloc + cmd_buf[count]='\0' before strchr); fs/btrfs/ioctl.c:2803 safe (fixed-size struct, name NUL-validated by btrfs_check_ioctl_vol_args_path); bfad_debugfs.c:253 is the seed location itself, not reportable. Mechanism confirmed by a guard-page PoC under $TMPDIR: sscanf("%s") on an unterminated 4-byte heap buffer placed flush against PROT_NONE faults (SIGSEGV). LIMITATIONS: bounded to s04's memdup_user/vmemdup_user string-consumer sweep (211 sites screened) plus targeted debugfs/ioctl paths — full per-ioctl copy_from_user audit and netlink nla_string policy audit not completed; all three findings are debugfs/root-gated so exploit impact beyond KASAN-class slab overread is not proven; ice overread is capped within the same slab object in most configs.
